digest.component_or_area: signed gate verdicts / provider provenance stamping
propositions: Signed gate verdicts currently record only a model string and cannot distinguish verdicts from different providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, Ollama) even when rebar signs all of them

A new additive-only provider_provenance object must be assembled once per run in runner.py and carried through all three sidecar writers, stamping provider, resolved model, endpoint_host, tier, and the effective ModelCapabilities record

endpoint_host must be extracted via urlparse().hostname (not .netloc) to prevent credentials from base_url appearing in persisted payloads, and this is a security oracle requiring negative-control testing

The provenance record must be assembled from primitives in capabilities.py (a leaf module) and reuse the capabilities record computed once at runner.py:357, never recomputing it, to avoid divergence from what actually drove the run
Backward compatibility requires the field to be optional and additive; legacy payloads lacking provider_provenance must still load and verify, with absence treated as 'unknown'

Provider provenance must flow through all five finalize_verdict call sites in workflow_ops.py and plan_review_recovery.py, carried from steps.verify.outputs for agent steps that hold the runner result
